$comment: Campaigns (lib/campaigns.js): the audiences a store sends to, the channels it sends on, and the policy every send follows. A campaign is sent only to people with a live grant for its purpose (lib/compliance.js mayProcess) — checked when the list is built and again just before each message — and every message carries a link that withdraws that grant. In-app messages reach shoppers' accounts; email and SMS go through the store's notification gateway (lib/mailer.js). Links in a message are tracked (a click counts, then goes on to the link) and an email carries a one-pixel image that counts the open; a store turns either off in settings campaigns.tracking.
